title: Global promote paths never check which checkout is the source — a linked git worktree promotes its unmerged code as the operator's global pi
description: Every path that writes the real global npm prefix derives its source tree from the script's own location (REPO_ROOT = the checkout the script runs in) and validates only the TARGET prefix (refuses a target resolving into REPO_ROOT; requires lib/node_modules). None checks whether the SOURCE checkout is the primary checkout or a linked git worktree. So `npm run promote:all` / `promote:cli` run inside any linked worktree packs and installs that worktree's code as the globally installed @davidorex set. The same holds for the automatic path: `core.hooksPath` is an absolute path into the primary checkout's `.husky/_`, so a commit in a linked worktree runs the primary checkout's `.husky/post-commit`, whose `npm run promote:all` resolves against the worktree's cwd — a worktree commit touching packages/ would promote the worktree's unmerged branch globally (derived from the code; not runtime-demonstrated). `release:*` step 5 reaches the same install via `npm run promote:cli`. The class is all real-global-mutating entry points; the throwaway-prefix arms (`--prefix`, `--prefix=`, `PROMOTE_PREFIX`) write no global state and are not part of the gap.

evidence.reference: REPO_ROOT resolved from the script's own path — the source is whatever checkout the script runs in
real-global arm (`npm prefix -g`) chosen when no override; containment refuses only a TARGET under REPO_ROOT; no source-checkout check anywhere
same shape: REPO_ROOT from script path, real-global arm, target-only containment

`npm run promote:all` on any commit touching packages/, run in the committing checkout's cwd; `git config core.hooksPath` = absolute path into the primary checkout's .husky/_, so linked worktrees run this hook
release step 5 runs `npm run promote:cli` in the running checkout
§4-§5: review establishing that main has no source-checkout gating and the substrate tracks none

impact: The operator's global pi / pi-context can silently become an unmerged feature branch's code whenever promote runs from, or a packages/-touching commit is made in, a linked worktree (including Claude Code `.claude/worktrees/*` agent worktrees). Dogfooded substrate reads/writes then run code that is not the integration branch's, and the next primary-checkout promote silently flips it back — the operator's behavior depends on which checkout last promoted.
proposed_resolution: Both promote scripts refuse the REAL-GLOBAL arm when the source checkout is a linked git worktree (detected via `git rev-parse --git-dir` differing from `--git-common-dir`), with a message naming the source checkout and the throwaway-prefix alternative; the `--prefix` / `--prefix=` / `PROMOTE_PREFIX` arms stay allowed from any checkout. `.husky/post-commit` skips its auto-promote in a linked worktree (exit 0, one-line notice) rather than failing. `release.mjs` inherits the refusal through promote:cli. Test coverage runs each script from a linked-worktree fixture and asserts refusal on the real-global arm and success on a throwaway prefix.
